drafts:

- **Plain draft:** supply `to`, `subject`, `text`, etc.
- **Reply:** set `in_reply_to` to a message ID. Recipients, subject, and
  threading are derived from that message. Set `reply_all` to address the
  whole thread (you then cannot also pass `to`, `cc`, or `bcc`).
- **Forward:** set `forward_of` to a message ID. The subject and threading
  are derived from the source message, whose body and attachments are
  merged in at send time.

`in_reply_to` and `forward_of` are mutually exclusive, and reading the
referenced message requires `message_read` permission.

get.description: Full-text search over threads in **every inbox in the account**. Returns `count`, `limit`, `next_page_token` and `threads`; page with `next_page_token`. Same fields as `get_agentmail_threads`, which is the one to use for everything in date order. This is the organization-wide view spanning every inbox in the account. Every AIsa caller shares one AgentMail account, so this reaches inboxes other callers created; the inbox-scoped twin `get_agentmail_inbox_threads_search` is the one to use when a single inbox is meant.
